notes.title: Update 2.1a Live Now!
notes.content:
1. Fixed Music restarting when competing sounds played like rapid firing bullets.
2. Level 3-2 Sprite rotations when moving up and down only
3. Performance improvements with lighting
4. When player was colliding with random objects, the floor calculation was triggering causing weird rotations.
5. Added Lumen support for higher end GPUs

notes.title: Heavy Metal Titans v2.0.0.18.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
You can now player two player cooperatively (locally) on your machines with multiple Xinput controllers.

Here's a secret:

On the main menu, if you hit shift+F12, you will be brought to a hidden online multiplayer screen. The online multiplayer is still in early Alpha and we're not sure if we're going to continue working on it... But if you like it and want us to keep working on it, please let us know!

notes.title: New Heavy Metal Titans v2.0.0.18 update
notes.content:
v2.0.0.18 Changes:
1. Walk/Run mode Axed. Now 1 key press prone functionality.
2. More... Way more Blood!
3. Gene Bomb Shop closer/ no requirement to building jump to fight.
4. Checkpoint level 1-1 on second portion of level.
5. Renzo Tank Tweaks.
6. Larger enemies on 2-3 Train Jetpack Fight.
7. 3-1 Teleporter bug fix
8. No Drop down Death spikes for 3-1.
9. End Credits take you back to Main Menu.
10. Immediate Shoot on click/press along with Auto.
11. 3-3 Dragon Boss Tweaks.
12. Visual Building teleporters on 1-1.
13. Gene Death Bug Fix (when he dies, he'd toss an additional bomb) - fixed
14. 2-3 last Building jump bug fixed.
15. larger hostages/collectibles on 2-2, and 3-2.
16. Loading Screens show Character Bios
17. World 1 Enemies don't auto aim
18. more Enemies and pickups on roof tops.
19. Better Grenade Explosive VFX.
20. Added Nightmare Mode in Settings (for those that are a glutton for punishment).
21. Added additional Streamer logos in some areas. (if you want a logo/brand to show up in game, hit us up).
22. Some specials don't show anything when enemies are not near by (bug fixed).
23. Bug fixes from new features. - Fixed
24. 3-3: Free flight mode (no auto progression [axed]).
25. Booby Trap (blades) have red to offset terrain color).
26. Faster movement on 2-2.
27. Fixed Final Boss World 2 bugs, better on screen prompts.
28. Fixed Tutorial to include keyboard buttons (you can set your own button assignments in settings as well).
29. Procedural Level Mode (Math Metal).

notes.title: Launch Day Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are launching tomorrow; however, we have to fix a few small issues with our game. 

What's this mean?
We will be launching later in the day, Thursday, June 15th.

Additionally, while the majority of development was done on a Windows machine, we were trying very hard to have both Windows and Mac versions of the game on launch day.

The bottom line is, we will only have the Windows version of the game available on launch, as we've come across numerous issues on our Mac build.

We are hoping next week to have the Mac build ready; or maybe we'll burn the midnight oil and have it ready by launch day, after all "anything is possible!".

Thank you for all of your support, we are working hard to make this game awesome for everyone!

Things we're working on for later updates after launch:
-More controller support (currently XBox One controllers and Keyboard/Mouse are only supported).
-Better Menu Controls
-Better Tutorial instructions for keyboard/mouse players

We're open to any and all feedback, so please send it up and we'll do our best to address and patch future releases.

-Squashed Bug Games LLC
